worlds.made: George's bird's-eye island (Recraft, 1:2, 768x1536), outpainted to 16:9 with Nano Banana 2.1 in Recraft (prompt below, variant A of 2), 23 Oct 2026
worlds.outpaintPrompt: The same calm turquoise ocean seen straight from above, continuing to the left and right edges: open water with soft wave lines and sparkles, a few small rocky islets with green trees and sandy rims, coral and reef patches, tiny white sailboats, sea turtles, and fluffy white clouds along the bottom edge. Same bright flat storybook illustration style, colours and lighting as the middle. One continuous seamless scene, no new big land, no text, no borders or frames.
worlds.upscale: Recraft Crisp upscale of the outpaint (1355x768 to 4096x2322) and of the island (to 1161x2322 at the same height), 23 Oct 2026
worlds.compose: tools/make-wiki-worlds.py: worlds.webp from worlds-outpaint.webp and worlds-island.webp (the island put back crisp in the middle, the new sea shaded to meet it); worlds-island.webp is also the tall picture for phones
